name: Formzard
author: Anwer Ashif

sections.description:
Formzard simplifies the creation of Contact Form 7 forms by offering pre-designed templates for common use cases. No more starting from scratch—just select a template, and you’re ready to go!

Key Features:
– Contact Us Form: A simple form with name, email, subject, and message fields.
– Event Registration Form: Capture attendee details for events.
– Newsletter Signup Form: Let users subscribe to your newsletter.
– Job Application Form: Allow applicants to submit resumes and contact details.
– Survey Form: Collect responses with multiple-choice questions.
– Donation Form: Accept donations with specified amounts.
– Appointment Booking Form: Schedule appointments with date and contact details.
– Feedback Form: Gather feedback and comments from users.
– Request a Quote Form: Provide project details and request a quote.
– and more templates…

Each template is crafted to work seamlessly with Contact Form 7 and can be further customized as needed.

How It Works:
1. Install and activate Formzard.
2. Navigate to the “Formzard” menu in your WordPress dashboard.
3. Select and import a pre-designed template.
4. Edit and publish your form using Contact Form 7.

Credits

This plugin was developed by Anwer to make Contact Form 7 more efficient and user-friendly.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/formzard directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Make sure Contact Form 7 is installed and activated before using Formzard.
  4. Go to “Formzard” in the WordPress admin menu to get started.
sections.faq:
Do I need to have Contact Form 7 installed?

Yes, Formzard works as an addon and requires Contact Form 7 to be installed and activated.

Can I customize the pre-designed templates?

Absolutely! Once imported, the templates can be edited within the Contact Form 7 interface.

Are the templates responsive?

Yes, all templates are designed to be mobile-friendly and responsive.

Can I add my own templates?

Currently, Formzard focuses on pre-designed templates, but you can manually create and manage your forms using Contact Form 7.
